rationale: Real BingX BTC-USDT/1m retention as of 2026-08-24 (Scalping Strategy Research Task S1) is 910,040 one-minute bars, earliest 2024-11-30T16:00:00Z, latest 2026-08-24T15:26:00Z (631.98-day span), 2 small confirmed real gaps -- confirmed by a real backfill.py run against the live production endpoint, see CLAUDE.md's 'Exchange API Facts -- BingX' section. UNLIKE every other holdout config in this directory, this one makes the ENTIRE available 1m dataset the holdout -- there is no separate 1m research split at all. This is Task S3's own design decision (CLAUDE.md's 'Scalping Strategy Research' section), made after computing the real detection-floor math: python/research/eligibility.py's PSR/DSR machinery resamples equity curves to DAILY granularity regardless of bars_per_day, so statistical power for a holdout confirmation is bounded by calendar days, not raw bar count. The entire 631.98-day (1.73-year) window gives a detection floor of only ~1.25 annualized Sharpe -- barely better than the already-spent 1h research window's own ~1.21, and splitting it into a research portion plus a smaller holdout would weaken the holdout's own power further for no benefit (Task S4's candidate is zero-fitted-parameter, so there is no fitting/searching step that actually needs a reusable research window). MECHANISM: holdout_cutoff_ms is set to the exact real earliest available 1m bar (1732982400000 = 2024-11-30T16:00:00Z, queried directly from python/data/var/klines.sqlite3, not hand-typed), with holdout_side='after' (the default every OTHER 1m/15m/1h config already uses, unlike holdout_1d.json's 'before'). Because no 1m data exists before this timestamp on BingX at all, the RESEARCH side (holdout_side='after' means research = everything BEFORE the cutoff) is trivially empty by construction -- research.holdout.load_research_klines against this config will always clamp to an empty range and raise, exactly as it already does for any other config's out-of-range research request. This is not a workaround; it is the natural consequence of the entire real dataset being reserved. BingX retention is rolling, not a fixed archive: like every other holdout config in this directory, the cutoff is fixed at the value it held on set_on and must not be moved to chase a future backfill's drifting earliest bar. WRITTEN BEFORE ANY RESULT: this cutoff and rationale were committed before Task S4's VWAP-mid-reversion strategy or its pre-registration were evaluated against any real 1m price data -- see .planning/scalp-s4-vwap-mid-reversion.md for the full account of what this task's own strategy/preregistration authoring did and did not touch.
